name: causal-ineq
description: Roadmap #9: the causal inequality, executed — the machine-verified theorem layer of the Oreshkov-Costa-Brukner process matrix framework. v0.1.0: exhaustive machine verification of the causal bound (all deterministic classical causal strategies swept, cap 3/4 exact), the process Born rule executed on exact complex algebra, the process validity constraints as executable certificates (the allowed-pattern rule derived from TPCP invariance), and the violation cos^2(pi/8) anchored on a machine-constructed valid process matrix with noise threshold 1/sqrt(2). v0.2.0 adds the optimality face (within ALL qubit-lab instruments — general POVMs, entangled CJ elements, arbitrary input-dependence — nothing beats cos^2(pi/8) on W*, proven by a functional relaxation whose every lemma is PSD/TP-level, with the biased OCB functional saturating the LC25 ICO bound) and the equivalence face (the derived W* is elementwise OCB12's published eq. 7 and LC25's S_OCB,1; the payoff functional derived twice, executed Born rule vs their closed forms, agrees entrywise; tampered transcriptions rejected by name). v0.3.0 is the code-quality wave (math frozen, results bit-identical): every kernel throw carries a named error code, all binary kernels reject dimension/shape mismatch instead of returning a silent NaN grid, the game constants single-sourced, dead exports and the root debug scratch retired — claims without certificates do not ship
